description: This PHP class 'BuzzEmbeddedURL' represents a URL that can be embedded, such as for videos. It provides functionality to retrieve an embedded version of the URL, validate it, and cache the embedded URL after generation. The class specifically supports generating embedded URLs for YouTube, Vimeo, and Dailymotion via auxiliary classes.

classes.name: BuzzEmbeddedURL
classes.description: A class to handle embedded URL extraction for video hosting platforms like YouTube, Vimeo, and Dailymotion, including validation and caching mechanisms.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object with the provided URL.

methods.name: getURL
methods.description: Returns the original URL stored in the object.

methods.name: getEmbeddedURL
methods.description: Returns the embedded URL if available; attempts to generate it for supported platforms, with caching.

methods.name: isValidURL
methods.description: Checks if the URL is valid by attempting to generate an embedded URL; returns false if invalid.
